name: Suit rack with spare suits
brief: MK-083 Suit locker with spare suits. Round 2, matched to the pick: a chunky framed wardrobe module, open at the front, with a warm-lit interior: an empty grown-up suit and an empty kid suit on hangers (no faces), helmets on the shelf, boots below, and a tall orange window in the door panel. Diegetic: a missing suit means someone is outside.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
